# Kaspa Links

> Non-custodial payment links, claim links and on-chain giveaways for Kaspa (KAS) mainnet. Payments go straight from the payer's wallet to the recipient's own Kaspa address. Kaspa Links never holds funds and charges no platform fee.

Kaspa Links is an independent, open-source community project. A payment link needs no account: paste your kaspa: address, choose whether payers pick the amount, pay a fixed price or fund a goal, and share the URL. Payers only need a Kaspa wallet, such as Kaspium, KasWare or Kastle. They need no account and no email. Kaspa payments confirm in about a second and are final.

## Create

- [Payment link](https://kaspalinks.com/new-link?start=paid): tips and donations (any amount), a fixed price, or a fundraising goal with a progress bar. No account needed.
- [Claim link](https://kaspalinks.com/claim/create): send KAS to someone without knowing their address. You pay once into a one-time on-chain output, the person who opens the link claims it, and unclaimed KAS returns to your wallet by itself.
- [Claim Drop](https://kaspalinks.com/claim/create?count=2): 2 to 8 claim links from one payment (needs a free profile).
- [On-chain giveaway](https://kaspalinks.com/giveaway/new): the prize is locked in a SilverScript contract on Kaspa, entries are recorded on-chain and free for entrants, a later Kaspa block picks the winner, and the contract pays only that winner. If nobody enters, the prize goes back.
- [Telegram bot](https://kaspalinks.com/bot): payment links, claim links and group giveaways inside Telegram.

## For AI assistants

- MCP server: `https://kaspalinks.com/api/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in). Tools: `prepare_payment_link`, `prepare_claim_link`, `prepare_giveaway`, `list_open_giveaways`. The prepare tools return a prefilled kaspalinks.com form. The user opens it, checks it and creates the link there. No tool creates a link or moves funds.
- Never ask a user for a seed phrase, private key, creator token or manage link. Kaspa Links never needs them.
- Kaspa Links runs on Kaspa mainnet only, so addresses start with `kaspa:`.
- Not supported yet: recurring payments, subscriptions, payment splits and tokens.
